bank.name: The Holy Quran
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: Revelation, compilation and structure of the Holy Quran, and key concepts related to it.

questions.prompt: How many Surahs (chapters) are there in the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: The Holy Quran contains 114 Surahs.

questions.prompt: Which Surah was revealed first to the Holy Prophet (PBUH) in the Cave of Hira?
questions.explanation: The first revelation was the first five verses of Surah Al-Alaq (96), received in the Cave of Hira.

questions.prompt: Over how many years was the Holy Quran revealed?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed gradually over about 23 years.

questions.prompt: Under which Caliph was the Holy Quran first compiled in book form?
questions.explanation: The Quran was first compiled during the caliphate of Abu Bakr (RA) on the suggestion of Umar (RA).

questions.prompt: Who was chosen to compile the Holy Quran during the caliphate of Abu Bakr (RA)?
questions.explanation: Zayd ibn Thabit (RA), the chief scribe, compiled the Quran into a single manuscript.

questions.prompt: Which Caliph sent standardised copies of the Quran to different regions?
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) standardised the text and dispatched copies to Islamic lands.

questions.prompt: Which is the longest Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah (2) is the longest Surah of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Which is the shortest Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kawthar (108) is the shortest Surah, with only three verses.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Fatiha, the opening chapter of the Quran, is also known as?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatiha is called Umm-ul-Kitab (the Mother of the Book) because it summarises the Quran.

questions.prompt: Into how many Juz (parts) is the Holy Quran divided?
questions.explanation: The Quran is divided into 30 Juz for ease of recitation, e.g. one per day in Ramadan.

questions.prompt: What is the commonly cited total number of verses (Ayahs) in the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: The Quran is commonly said to contain 6,666 verses (scholarly counts vary slightly).

questions.prompt: The Night of Power, better than a thousand months, falls in which month?
questions.explanation: Laylat-ul-Qadr falls in the last ten nights of Ramadan (Surah Al-Qadr, 97).

questions.prompt: Which Surah mentions that the Night of Power is better than a thousand months?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Qadr (97) describes Laylat-ul-Qadr as better than a thousand months.

questions.prompt: Most of the Quranic Surahs were revealed in which city?
questions.explanation: About 86 Surahs are Meccan and about 28 are Medinan.

questions.prompt: In which year of the Islamic calendar was the Qibla changed from Jerusalem to the Kaaba?
questions.explanation: The Qibla was changed to the Kaaba in the second year after Hijrah (2 AH).

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Masad (Lahab) was revealed about which enemy of Islam?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Masad condemns Abu Lahab, an uncle of the Prophet who opposed Islam.

questions.prompt: In which language was the Holy Quran revealed?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed in clear Arabic (Surah Ash-Shu'ara 26:195).

questions.prompt: People who have memorised the entire Holy Quran are called?
questions.explanation: A Hafiz (plural Huffaz) is a person who has memorised the whole Quran.

questions.prompt: How many words are there approximately in the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: The Quran contains about 77,000 words (approximately 77,430).

questions.prompt: What is the meaning of the abbreviation 'Alif Lam Meem' (الم)?
options: Mysterious letters whose full meaning is known only to Allah
questions.explanation: The Muqatta'at (disjointed letters) like Alif Lam Meem are among the verses whose full meaning is known to Allah.

questions.prompt: Which is the first Surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fatiha (The Opening) is the first Surah of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Which is the last Surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nas (Mankind) is the 114th and last Surah of the Quran.

questions.prompt: How many letters are there approximately in the Quran?
questions.explanation: The Quran contains about 323,000 letters.

questions.prompt: How many Ruku (sections) are there in the Quran?
questions.explanation: The Quran is divided into about 540 Ruku (paragraph-like sections).

questions.prompt: Which Surah is named after a female figure (Maryam)?
questions.explanation: Surah Maryam (19th Surah) is named after Maryam (Mary), mother of Isa (AS).

questions.prompt: Which Surah is known as the 'Surah of the Bees'?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nahl (The Bee), the 16th Surah, is named after the bee.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called the 'Surah of the Ant'?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Naml (The Ant), the 27th Surah, mentions the ant in the story of Sulaiman (AS).

questions.prompt: Which Surah is named after the spider?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ankabut (The Spider), the 29th Surah, uses the spider's web as a parable.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is named after a metal (iron)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Hadid (Iron), the 57th Surah, mentions the sending down of iron.

questions.prompt: In which Surah is the 'Verse of the Throne' (Ayat-ul-Kursi) present?
questions.explanation: Ayat-ul-Kursi is 2:255 of Surah Al-Baqarah.

questions.prompt: The Quran describes itself as 'Hudan-lil-Muttaqin' (guidance for the God-conscious) at the start of which Surah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:2 calls the Quran guidance for the Muttaqin (God-conscious).

questions.prompt: How many Surahs begin with the 'Muqatta'at' (disjointed letters)?
questions.explanation: 29 Surahs begin with disjointed letters like Alif Lam Meem.

questions.prompt: Which is the 50th Surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah Qaf (The Letter Qaf) is the 50th Surah.

questions.prompt: Which Surah contains the story of the two gardens of the wealthy man?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kahf narrates the parable of the man with two gardens (18:32-44).

questions.prompt: Which Surah was revealed in response to the Quraysh's demand to see a sign, and speaks of the moon splitting?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Qamar (The Moon) opens with 'The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split.'

questions.prompt: Which Surah is entirely about the story of Prophet Hud's people?
questions.explanation: Surah Hud, the 11th Surah, is named after and recounts Prophet Hud (AS).

questions.prompt: How many times does the word 'Allah' appear in the Quran?
questions.explanation: The word 'Allah' appears about 2,699 times in the Quran.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the 36th Surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah Yaseen is the 36th Surah.

questions.prompt: Which Surah mentions the 'Jinn' listening to the Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Jinn (The Jinn), the 72nd Surah, recounts jinn listening to the recitation.

questions.prompt: What is the literal meaning of 'Surah'?
questions.explanation: Surah means a chapter, and its root also conveys elevation or rank.

questions.prompt: Which is the 112th Surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ikhlas (Sincerity) is the 112th Surah.

questions.prompt: Which Surah deals with the punishment of Abu Lahab?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Masad (The Palm Fiber), the 111th Surah, condemns Abu Lahab and his wife.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is known as 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad' and is the essence of Tawheed?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ikhlas begins 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad' — Say: He is Allah, the One.

questions.prompt: The Quran has how many names of Allah listed in it as attributes?
questions.explanation: The '99 Beautiful Names' (Asma-ul-Husna) are drawn from the Quran and hadith.

questions.prompt: Which Surah discusses the laws of inheritance?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nisa (Women) contains the detailed laws of inheritance (4:11-12).

questions.prompt: Which Surah commands the believers to lower their gaze?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nur (24:30-31) commands lowering the gaze and modesty.

questions.prompt: In which Surah does Allah address humanity as 'Ya Ayyuhal Nas'?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nisa (4:1) opens with 'O mankind (Ya Ayyuhal Nas)...'

questions.prompt: Which Surah mentions the Zakat along with Salah most frequently?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah repeatedly couples Salah and Zakat as the foundations of worship and charity.

questions.prompt: Which is the longest surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Baqarah is the longest surah.

questions.prompt: Which is the shortest surah of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Kawthar is the shortest surah.

questions.prompt: The first surah of the Quran is:
questions.explanation: Al-Fatihah is the opening surah.

questions.prompt: Which surah is called the 'Heart of the Quran'?
questions.explanation: Ya-Sin is known as the heart of the Quran.

questions.prompt: The last surah of the Quran is:
questions.explanation: An-Nas is the 114th and final surah.

questions.prompt: Which surah is known as the 'Glory of the Quran'?
questions.explanation: Ar-Rahman is called the glory of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Fatihah contains how many verses?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatihah has 7 verses.

questions.prompt: The Quran was revealed over how many years?
questions.explanation: Revelation spanned about 23 years.

questions.prompt: The first revelation was received in which cave?
questions.explanation: The first verses came in the Cave of Hira.

questions.prompt: Which surah was revealed entirely at once?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatihah is said to have been revealed complete.

questions.prompt: Which surah is called the 'Mother of the Book' (Umm-ul-Kitab)?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatihah is called Umm-ul-Kitab.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Ikhlas is equivalent to:
questions.explanation: Al-Ikhlas carries the reward of a third of the Quran.

questions.prompt: The longest verse of the Quran is in which surah?
questions.explanation: Ayat-ul-Dayn (2:282) is the longest verse.

questions.prompt: The Throne Verse (Ayat-ul-Kursi) is in which surah?
questions.explanation: Ayat-ul-Kursi is 2:255 in Al-Baqarah.

questions.prompt: Which surah describes the Day of Judgment?
questions.explanation: Al-Qariah vividly describes the Day of Judgment.

questions.prompt: The term 'Al-Quran' literally means:
questions.explanation: Quran means the recitation.

questions.prompt: The Quran was first compiled into a single book during the caliphate of:
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr ordered the first compilation.

questions.prompt: The standardised copies of the Quran were distributed during:
questions.explanation: Uthman standardised the Quranic text.

questions.prompt: Surah Ya-Sin begins with which Arabic letters?
questions.explanation: Ya-Sin opens with the letters Ya Seen.

questions.prompt: The Quran mentions how many times the word 'Allah' appears?
questions.explanation: Allah is mentioned about 2,699 times.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Mulk is also called:
questions.explanation: Al-Mulk intercedes for its reciter.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called the 'Bride of the Quran' (Aroos-ul-Quran)?
questions.explanation: Surah Ar-Rahman is popularly known as the Bride of the Quran.

questions.prompt: What is the 55th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Ar-Rahman is the 55th Surah of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Which is the second longest Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: After Al-Baqarah, Surah Al-Imran is the second longest.

questions.prompt: How many Surahs of the Quran are commonly counted as Makki?
questions.explanation: The standard count is 86 Makki and 28 Madani Surahs.

questions.prompt: How many Surahs of the Quran are commonly counted as Madani?
questions.explanation: The standard count is 28 Madani and 86 Makki Surahs.

questions.prompt: Which Surah contains the name of Allah in every single verse?
questions.explanation: The name of Allah appears in every verse of Surah Al-Mujadila (58).

questions.prompt: Besides Maryam, which Surah of the Quran is named after a woman?
questions.explanation: Al-Mujadila is named after the woman who argued with the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: The word 'Wahy' means?
questions.explanation: Wahy is the divine revelation sent by Allah to the prophets.

questions.prompt: Which Surah of the Quran is named after Prophet Nuh (AS)?
questions.explanation: Surah Nuh is the 71st chapter, named after the Prophet Nuh (AS).

questions.prompt: Which Surah of the Quran is named after Prophet Ibrahim (AS)?
questions.explanation: Surah Ibrahim is the 14th chapter, named after the Prophet Ibrahim (AS).

questions.prompt: The command for the Friday (Jumu'ah) prayer is given in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Jumu'ah (62:9) commands the believers to hasten to the Friday prayer.

questions.prompt: Which Surah deals with the conduct of the hypocrites (Munafiqun)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Munafiqun (63) exposes the traits of the hypocrites.

questions.prompt: The rules of divorce (Talaq) are laid down in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Surah At-Talaq (65) contains the injunctions of divorce.

questions.prompt: What is the 57th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Hadid (the Iron) is the 57th chapter.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is named after the Night Journey of the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Isra (17) is named after the Night Journey.

questions.prompt: The shortest Surah, Al-Kawthar, contains how many verses?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kawthar consists of only three verses.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called the 'Surah of the Women' for its many rulings on family law?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nisa (4) is called the Surah of the Women.

questions.prompt: The word 'Ayat' (as used for Quranic verses) literally means?
questions.explanation: Ayat means signs or miracles; each verse is a sign of Allah.

questions.prompt: What is the 99th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Az-Zalzalah (the Earthquake) is the 99th chapter.

questions.prompt: Which Surah mentions the pledge of Ridwan and the victory of the treaty era?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fath (48) was revealed after the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah.

questions.prompt: The term 'Juz' literally means?
questions.explanation: Juz means a part; the Quran is divided into thirty Juz.

questions.prompt: The longest Surah, Al-Baqarah, contains how many verses?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah has 286 verses.

questions.prompt: What is the 60th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Mumtahanah (the Examined Woman) is the 60th chapter.

questions.prompt: The literal meaning of 'Al-A'raf' (the 7th Surah) is?
options: The Heights (the elevated place between Paradise and Hell)
questions.explanation: Al-A'raf is the Heights between Paradise and Hell mentioned in the Surah.

questions.prompt: What is the 78th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: An-Naba (the Great News) is the 78th chapter.

questions.prompt: The word 'Tanzil' means?
questions.explanation: Tanzil refers to the Quran as sent down from Allah.

questions.prompt: The literal meaning of 'Al-Baqarah' (the 2nd Surah) is?
questions.explanation: Al-Baqarah means the Cow, from the story of the cow of Bani Israel.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is named after the private rooms of the Prophet's (PBUH) wives?
questions.explanation: Al-Hujurat (49) is named after the apartments of the Prophet's (PBUH) household.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is also called 'Al-Bara'ah' (the Repudiation)?
questions.explanation: At-Tawbah is also known as Al-Bara'ah and is the only Surah without Bismillah.

questions.prompt: What is the 4th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: An-Nisa (the Women) is the fourth chapter.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Imran is named after whom?
options: The family of Imran (father of Maryam)
questions.explanation: Al-Imran is named after the family of Imran, ancestors of Maryam and Isa (AS).
